first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation, and prior evidence indicates it improves time-to-value and early adoption for self-serve/SMB accounts. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than reacting to competitive pricing without first validating its downstream margin and quality effects. Verify the directly relevant onboarding result and the consequential pricing alternative before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding raised completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%, directly addressing both current completion and activation declines while supporting durable value. Promotional pricing is ruled out for the primary objective: despite acquisition lift, its verified cohort retention declined 12% before renewal. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation to ensure the current effect persists.
